terms.target_grant: Signed, time-bounded authorisation for an exact target with ports, techniques, exclusions and approver evidence.
terms.finding_truth: Petraclus-owned severity, verification state and evidence linkage; models may propose but not silently mutate.
terms.observed_scanner_fact: Raw or redacted scanner observation labelled as observed, not inference.
terms.feed_data: External intel feed payload treated as untrusted input.
terms.model_inference: Keprix-generated explanation or prioritisation that must cite asset/finding/evidence ids.
terms.human_verification: Operator-confirmed state recorded by Petraclus workflows.
terms.soft_wall: Proposal or action that requires product preview and human approval before apply.
terms.edition: Community, Pro or Team entitlement returned by Petraclus licence/effective-entitlements.
terms.airgap: Mode with no licence, telemetry, feed or update phone-home unless explicitly configured.
terms.provenance_label: Label distinguishing observed scanner fact, feed data, model inference and human verification.
